name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 8 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-06-29, at wavelengths from 0.85 to 4.86 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
